result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the page, both related to truncated or clipped content in horizontally scrollable sections.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is abruptly cut off mid-word without an ellipsis. The card is partially clipped to hint at horizontal scrollability, but the text label underneath the card is also clipped, which looks broken rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccolo…') to the restaurant name label so it reads cleanly even when the card is partially off-screen. Alternatively, ensure the text label is fully contained within the visible portion of the card.

issues.description: The category filter pill row shows a partially visible pill on the far right edge, with no clear affordance (e.g., a fade/gradient overlay or scroll arrow) to indicate more options are available. This can appear visually broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a horizontal fade-out gradient on the right edge of the filter pill row to clearly communicate that the list is scrollable, improving the perceived polish and usability.
